arxiv-1705-00133.title: Relational ⋆ \star -Liftings for Differential Privacy
arxiv-1705-00133.creator: Gilles Barthe, Thomas Espitau, Justin Hsu, Tetsuya Sato, Pierre-Yves Strub
arxiv-1705-00133.description: Abstract . Recent developments in formal verification have identified approximate liftings (also known as approximate couplings ) as a clean, compositional abstraction for proving differential privacy. This construction can be defined in two styles. Earlier definitions require the existence of one or more witness distributions , while a recent definition by Sato uses universal quantification over all sets of samples.

arxiv-2110-04389.title: Tight Computationally Efficient Approximation of Matrix Norms with Applications
arxiv-2110-04389.creator: Anatoli Juditsky, Georgios Kotsalis, Arkadi Nemirovski
arxiv-2110-04389.description: Abstract We address the problems of computing operator norms of matrices induced by given norms on the argument and the image space. It is known that aside of a fistful of “solvable cases,” most notably, the case when both given norms are Euclidean, computing operator norm of a matrix is NP-hard.

arxiv-2205-11193.title: Conductance matrix symmetries of multiterminal semiconductor-superconductor devices
arxiv-2205-11193.creator: Andrea Maiani, Max Geier, Karsten Flensberg
arxiv-2205-11193.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Andrea Maiani, Max Geier, Karsten Flensberg. Nonlocal tunneling spectroscopy of multiterminal semiconductor-superconductor hybrid devices is a powerful tool to investigate the Andreev bound states below the parent superconducting gap. We examine how to exploit both microscopic and geometrical symmetries of the system to extract information on the normal and Andreev transmission probabilities from the multiterminal electric or thermoelectric differential conductance matrix under the assumption of an electrostatic potential landscape independent of the bias voltages, as well as the absence of leakage currents.

arxiv-2206-06947.title: K-Space Transformer for Undersampled MRI Reconstruction
arxiv-2206-06947.creator: Ziheng Zhao, Tianjiao Zhang, Weidi Xie †, Yanfeng Wang †, Ya Zhang
arxiv-2206-06947.description: Abstract This paper considers the problem of undersampled MRI reconstruction. We propose a novel Transformer-based framework for directly processing signal in k-space, going beyond the limitation of regular grids as ConvNets do. We adopt an implicit representation of k-space spectrogram, treating spatial coordinates as inputs, and dynamically query the sparsely sampled points to reconstruct the spectrogram, i.e.

arxiv-2208-02501.title: Aiming in Harsh Environments: A New Framework for Flexible and Adaptive Resource Management
arxiv-2208-02501.creator: Jiaqi Zou, Rui Liu, Chenwei Wang, Yuanhao Cui, Zixuan Zou, Songlin Sun, Koichi Adachi
arxiv-2208-02501.description: Abstract The harsh environment imposes a unique set of challenges on networking strategies. In such circumstances, the environmental impact on network resources and long-time unattended maintenance has not been well investigated yet. To address these challenges, we propose a flexible and adaptive resource management framework that incorporates the environment-awareness functionality.

arxiv-2210-04092.title: Advancing Model Pruning via Bi-level Optimization
arxiv-2210-04092.creator: Yihua Zhang, Yuguang Yao, Parikshit Ram, Pu Zhao, Tianlong Chen, Mingyi Hong, Yanzhi Wang, Sijia Liu
arxiv-2210-04092.description: Abstract The deployment constraints in practical applications necessitate the pruning of large-scale deep learning models, i.e. , promoting their weight sparsity. As illustrated by the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH), pruning also has the potential of improving their generalization ability. At the core of LTH, iterative magnitude pruning (IMP) is the predominant pruning method to successfully find ‘winning tickets’.

arxiv-2304-05444.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tiffany Tseng, Jennifer King Chen, Mona Abdelrahman, Mary Beth Kery, Fred Hohman, Adriana Hilliard, R. Benjamin Shapiro. Existing novice-friendly machine learning (ML) modeling tools center around a solo user experience, where a single user collects only their own data to build a model.

arxiv-2310-02154.title: Program Structure Aware Precondition Generation
arxiv-2310-02154.creator: Elizabeth Dinella, Shuvendu Lahiri, Mayur Naik
arxiv-2310-02154.description: Abstract We introduce a novel approach for inferring natural preconditions as a segment of code. Prior works, which generate preconditions from scratch through combinations of boolean predicates, often create preconditions which are difficult to read and comprehend. Our approach, instead, generates a precondition through a series of program transformations over the target method.

arxiv-2310-15183.title: Graphical Processing of Geodesic Propagation in Python
arxiv-2310-15183.creator: Frank Imbens
arxiv-2310-15183.description: Abstract Black holes and other compact objects are powerful tools to observationally test Einsteins theory of General Relativity. We develop raytracing code to create visual images of compact objects that are solutions of Einsteins field equations. These include Kerr black holes and Manko-Novikov spacetimes with extra independent multipole moments.

arxiv-2412-14130.title: Examples of cyclic polynomially bounded operators that are not similar to contractions
arxiv-2412-14130.creator: Maria F. Gamal’
arxiv-2412-14130.description: Abstract . A question if a polynomially bounded operator is similar to a contraction was posed by Halmos and was answered in the negative by Pisier. His counterexample is an operator of infinite multiplicity, while all its restrictions on invariant subspaces of finite multiplicity are similar to contractions.

arxiv-2501-18896.title: Single-defect mode lasing in a non-Hermitian 1D trivial SSH lattice
arxiv-2501-18896.creator: Abouzar Gharajeh0‡, Kiyanoush Goudarzi0‡, Fargol Seifollahi, Qing Gu
arxiv-2501-18896.description: Abstract We demonstrate robust single-mode lasing in a non-Hermitian 1D trivial Su-Schrieffer-Heeger defective lattice. This structure exhibits a significantly lower threshold power compared to the non-defective lattice, with single-mode lasing sustained across a wide range of pump powers. Notably, our proposed device requires pumping of only the defect ring, leading to minimal required pump power.

arxiv-2503-12298.title: Computing Modes of Instability of Parameterized Nonlinear Systems for Vulnerability Assessment
arxiv-2503-12298.creator: Jinghan Wang, Michael W. Fisher
arxiv-2503-12298.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jinghan Wang, Michael W. Fisher. Engineered systems naturally experience large disturbances which have the potential to disrupt desired operation because the system may fail to recover to a desired stable equilibrium point. It is valuable to determine the mechanism of instability when the system is subject to a particular finite-time disturbance, because this information can be used to improve vulnerability detection, and to design controllers to reduce vulnerability.

arxiv-2505-00448.title: NApy: Efficient Statistics in Python for Large-Scale Heterogeneous Data with Enhanced Support for Missing Data DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX
arxiv-2505-00448.creator: Fabian Woller, Lis Arend, Christian Fuchsberger, Markus List, David B. Blumenthal
arxiv-2505-00448.description: Abstract . Existing Python libraries and tools lack the ability to efficiently compute statistical test results for large datasets in the presence of missing values. This presents an issue as soon as constraints on runtime and memory availability become essential considerations for a particular usecase.

arxiv-2507-09427.title: Justification Logic for Intuitionistic Modal Logic (Extended Technical Report)
arxiv-2507-09427.creator: Sonia Marin, Paaras Padhiar
arxiv-2507-09427.description: Abstract Justification logics are an explication of modal logic; boxes are replaced with proof terms formally through realisation theorems. This can be achieved syntactically using a cut-free proof system e.g. using sequent, hypersequent or nested sequent calculi. In constructive modal logic, boxes and diamonds are decoupled and not De Morgan dual.

arxiv-2508-13063.creator: Chongying Dong, Siu-Hung Ng, Li Ren, Feng Xu
arxiv-2508-13063.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chongying Dong, Siu-Hung Ng, Li Ren, Feng Xu. Let A A be a condensable algebra in a modular tensor category 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . europmc-pmc5827158.description: This review proposes that lipopolysaccharide (LPS, found in the wall of all Gram-negative bacteria) could play a role in causing sporadic Alzheimer's disease (AD). This is based in part upon recent studies showing that: Gram-negative E. coli bacteria can form extracellular...

europmc-pmc6647104.title: Celiac disease: a comprehensive current review.
europmc-pmc6647104.creator: Caio G, Volta U, Sapone A, Leffler DA, De Giorgio R, Catassi C, Fasano A.
europmc-pmc6647104.description: Background Celiac disease remains a challenging condition because of a steady increase in knowledge tackling its pathophysiology, diagnosis, management, and possible therapeutic options. Main body A major milestone in the history of celiac disease was the identification of tissu

pmc-10555016.title: THU621 Mifepristone In Exogenous Cushing's Syndrome
pmc-10555016.creator: Swetha Priyadarshan, Delali Ohui Blavo
pmc-10555016.description: Disclosure: S. Priyadarshan: None. D.O. Blavo: None. Introduction: Cushing’s syndrome is characterized by elevated cortisol levels in the body and is associated with significant morbidity and mortality. It can be broadly divided into endogenous and exogenous Cushing’s depending on etiology.

pmc-10618230.title: Enhancement of various images using coefficients obtained from a class of Sakaguchi type functions
pmc-10618230.creator: B Aarthy, B Srutha Keerthi
pmc-10618230.description: Digital image processing has a wide range of uses, including robotics and automated inspection of industrial parts. Other uses include remote sensing using satellites and other spacecraft, image transmission and storage for business applications, medical processing, and Acoustic image processing. The process of highlighting particular intriguing features in a hidden image is known as image enhancement.

pmc-11351161.title: Germplasm Resources and Genetic Breeding of Huang-Qi (Astragali Radix): A Systematic Review
pmc-11351161.creator: Pengbin Dong, Lingjuan Wang, Yong Chen, Liyang Wang, Wei Liang, Hongyan Wang, Jiali Cheng, Yuan Chen, Fengxia Guo
pmc-11351161.description: Simple SummaryAstragalus species (Huang-Qi), belonging to Fabaceae, are widely spread in the arid to semiarid environments in northeast, north, and northwest China, and most of the varieties thereof have dual-use functions as medicine and food, with the potential to become high-quality health food.

pmc-11443556.title: Genomic epidemiology of Clostridioides difficile sequence type 35 reveals intraspecies and interspecies clonal transmission
pmc-11443556.creator: Yun Luo, Yu Chen, Shan Lin, Hui Hu, Xiaojun Song, Qiao Bian, Weijia Fang, Huoyang Lv, Qin Wang, Jianmin Jiang, Yi-Wei Tang, Dazhi Jin
pmc-11443556.description: Clostridioides difficile sequence type (ST) 35 has been found in humans and animals worldwide. However, its genomic epidemiology and clonal transmission have not been explored in detail. In this study, 176 C. difficile ST35 isolates from six countries were sequenced. Genomic diversity, clonal transmission and epidemiological data were analyzed. Sporulation and virulence capacities were measured.

pmc-11540932.title: A Qualitative Exploration of the Socioecological Influences Shaping the Diagnostic Experience and Self‐Management Practices Among People Newly Diagnosed With Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-11540932.creator: Olivia Wills, Sarah Manche, Yasmine Probst
pmc-11540932.description: BackgroundPeople newly diagnosed with multiple sclerosis (MS) often pursue ‘health‐related’ behaviour changes to feel in control of their diagnosis. However, little is known about the specific factors that may influence behaviour change during this crucial time. Therefore, we conducted an in‐depth exploration of the socioecological influences impacting the diagnostic experience and self‐management practices following an MS diagnosis.

pmc-11557262.title: Bilateral orchidopexy for intermittent testicular torsion
pmc-11557262.creator: Paul K Hegarty, Mona Kalantar, Penelope A Hegarty, Helen Zafirakis, Jack E Monahan
pmc-11557262.description: ObjectivesTo assess the effect of bilateral orchidopexy in preventing future torsion and testicular loss in patients with intermittent testicular torsion. Secondarily, this study aims to assess the rate of pain improvement following orchidopexy.MethodsThis is a prospective cohort of patients. Participants were men who underwent elective bilateral orchidopexy for intermittent testicular torsion.

pmc-12467089.title: Joint Modulation of Postural and Neural Correlates in Response to Motivational Images in Non-Clinical Drinkers
pmc-12467089.creator: Amel Zitouni, Mbarka Akounach, Sumeyye Kızılışık, Salvatore Campanella, Ardalan Aarabi, Thierry Lelard, Harold Mouras, Romain Goutagny
pmc-12467089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryImages that carry motivational value, such as food or drink, can rapidly capture attention and trigger bodily adjustments, often outside of conscious awareness. These early reactions may play an important role in guiding everyday behavior. In this study, we combined two measures to explore how young adults respond to such images: subtle body movements recorded through posture, and rapid brain activity recorded through electrical signals at the scalp.

pmc-12764971.title: A multi-task deep learning approach for landslide displacement prediction with applications in early warning systems
pmc-12764971.creator: Damjan Strnad, Domen Mongus, Štefan Horvat, Ela Šegina
pmc-12764971.description: Accurate landslide displacement prediction is important for the construction of reliable landslide early warning systems (LEWS). Recently, deep neural networks have become the dominant approach for landslide displacement modeling. However, we show that focusing solely on low prediction residuals is not perfectly aligned with the goals of LEWS, where the emphasis is on precise forecasts near the warning threshold.

pmc-12836810.title: Phylograd: fast column-specific calculation of substitution model gradients
pmc-12836810.creator: Benjamin Lieser, Georgy Belousov, Johannes Söding
pmc-12836810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMost popular tools for reconstructing phylogenetic trees from multiple sequence alignments use a model of molecular evolution in which a single substitution matrix or a small set of fixed matrices are shared between all columns.

pmc-12989378.title: Thromboembolic disease in testicular germ cell tumors—real-world evidence of three Portuguese institutions
pmc-12989378.creator: Joana Albuquerque, Martim Oliveira, Diana Neto-Silva, Inês Margarido, Jorge Correia, Carlota Baptista, Madalena Machete, Rita Bizarro, João Rato, João Godinho, José Alberto Teixeira, José Luís Passos-Coelho
pmc-12989378.description: IntroductionTesticular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) are highly curable malignancies with long-term overall survival (OS) exceeding 90%. Thromboembolic (TE) events are a relevant treatment-related complication, reported in approximately 10% of patients. This study aimed to evaluate the incidence, risk factors, and prognostic impact of TE in TGCT.

pmc-13031649.title: A gated-attention multi-prior injection diffusion model for Huashan rock art image restoration
pmc-13031649.creator: Tong Zhao, Luohua Huang, Xiaopeng Qi, Penglu Deng
pmc-13031649.description: This paper addresses the problems of fading, loss, and texture degradation in the Zuojiang Huashan rock art caused by long term weathering and human disturbances, and constructs a Huashan rock art dataset for image restoration while proposing a prior guided restoration framework based on Stable Diffusion.

pmc-13136346.title: Uncovering the structural influence of urban park landscapes on psychological restoration via graph learning
pmc-13136346.creator: Yujie Zhang, Yaping Li, Yanchuan Yin, Ying Jin, Guodong Sun
pmc-13136346.description: Over half of global population now resides in urban areas, where mental health challenges such as anxiety and depression are increasingly prevalent. Urban park landscapes are recognized as critical settings for promoting psychological restoration, yet a systematic understanding of what makes these spaces restorative remains limited.

pmc-13366518.title: Design principles for integrated AI alignment
pmc-13366518.creator: Ben Y Reis, William G La Cava
pmc-13366518.description: SummaryAs AI adoption accelerates across human society, the problem of aligning AI models with human preferences remains a grand challenge. Currently, the AI alignment field is deeply divided between behavioral and representational approaches, resulting in narrowly aligned models that are more vulnerable to increasingly deceptive misalignment threats.

pmc-13387498.title: No more counting sheep? Interoceptive not-distracting as a novel predictor of insomnia symptom severity in college students
pmc-13387498.creator: Lara R LoBrutto, Natalie D Dautovich, Patricia A Kinser, Bruce Rybarczyk, Joseph Dzierzewski
pmc-13387498.description: Study ObjectivesEmerging adults demonstrate vulnerability to pre-sleep arousal due to pervasive electronic device use, heightened rumination, and higher overall anxiety. To address this concern, this study sought to assess interoceptive awareness, a non-judgmental and trusting attitude toward body sensations that may reduce pre-sleep arousal, as a protective factor against insomnia symptoms during young adulthood.
